name: io.github.ryoangriawan96/midtrans-mcp
description: MCP server for Midtrans (Indonesian payment gateway): status, Snap, payment links, cancel, refund.

environmentVariables.name: MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Midtrans Server Key (use a Sandbox key for testing).

environmentVariables.name: MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION
environmentVariables.description: Set to true for the production API; anything else means Sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: MIDTRANS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only the read-only transaction-status tool.
